content.short: Teahouse is a DeFi platform that provides secure and flexible asset management.
content.description: Teahouse Finance is a DeFi platform offering flexible asset management with a focus on concentrated liquidity provision on Uniswap V3 and Perpetual Protocol. It features a dynamic price-band strategy, TeaVault smart contracts, and a liquidity-provision simulator. The project has completed two fundraising rounds led by Pantera and NGC Ventures. Teahouse aims to build seamless infrastructure that lets non-DeFi-savvy strategists model advanced concentrated liquidity and collaborate with third-party strategy providers. It plans to add more strategies, grow assets under management, and maintain an online DeFi community for enthusiasts and experts.
